# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀掃描 mailbox 的 inbox 與 done Markdown 信件，輸出一行 JSON；不修復或改寫資料。

## 第一次跑

在原型根目錄執行：

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo <folder> --now 2026-10-09T19:00:00+08:00
```

`--now` 必須是帶時區的 ISO 時間。信件中未帶時區的 `at` 使用它的時區；工具不讀系統時鐘。成功時 stdout 只有一行 JSON，包含 `v`、`open`、`boxes`、`bad`；參數錯誤退出碼為 2，stdout 為空。只掃描非隱藏 mailbox 的 `inbox/*.md` 和 `inbox/done/*.md` 非隱藏一般檔案，不跟隨符號連結。

測試：`python3 tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests`。獨立核對：`python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture`。

"""CLI behavior and read-only mailbox tests."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T19:00:00+02:00"


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.root.mkdir()

    def run_cli(self, folder=None, *args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), str(folder or self.root),
                               *args], capture_output=True, text=True)

    def write(self, relative, content):
        path = self.root / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def letter(self, relative, ident, status="REQUEST", target="t",
               at="2026-10-09T18:00:00", reply=None):
        fields = {"id": ident, "from": "sender", "to": target,
                  "status": status, "at": at}
        if reply is not None:
            fields["re"] = reply
        self.write(relative, "---\n" + "".join(
            "%s: %s\n" % pair for pair in fields.items()) + "---\nbody\n")

    def test_summary_counts_resolution_order_and_ignored_paths(self):
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261009T1800-a.md", "a", target="other",
                    at="2026-10-09T18:00:30")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261009T1801-p.md", "p", status="PROGRESS", reply="c")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261009T1901-c.md", "c", target="z",
                    at="2026-10-09T19:01:00")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/done/20261009T1810-first.md", "dup", target="a",
                    at="2026-10-09T18:10:00")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261009T1820-second.md", "dup")
        self.letter("beta/inbox/done/20261009T1830-answer.md", "answer",
                    status="DONE", reply="a")
        (self.root / "gamma" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
        self.write("alpha/inbox/notes.md", "not frontmatter\n")
        self.write("alpha/inbox/missing.md", "---\nid: x\n---\n")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261309T1820-invalid.md", "invalid")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/.hidden.md", "hidden")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/sub/20261009T1800-nested.md", "nested")
        self.letter(".private/inbox/20261009T1800-secret.md", "secret")
        self.letter("alpha/inbox/20261009T1800-ignored.txt", "ignored")
        result = self.run_cli(None, "--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(len(result.stdout.splitlines()), 1)
        self.assertTrue(result.stdout.endswith("\n"))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {
            "v": 1,
            "open": [
                {"id": "dup", "from": "sender", "to": "t", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 60},
                {"id": "c", "from": "sender", "to": "z", "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1}
            ],
            "boxes": {
                "alpha": {"inbox": {"PROGRESS": 1, "REQUEST": 3}, "done": 0},
                "beta": {"inbox": {}, "done": 1},
                "gamma": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}
            },
            "bad": [
                {"file": "alpha/inbox/20261309T1820-invalid.md", "why": "bad_name"},
                {"file": "alpha/inbox/done/20261009T1810-first.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                {"file": "alpha/inbox/missing.md", "why": "no_field"},
                {"file": "alpha/inbox/notes.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"}
            ]
        })

    def test_validation_precedence_and_last_frontmatter_value(self):
        self.write("box/inbox/20261009T1800-first.md",
                   "---\nid: first\nfrom: sender\nto: t\nstatus: DONE\nstatus: REQUEST\n"
                   "at: 2026-10-09T18:00:00+02:00\nre: \n---\n")
        self.letter("box/inbox/20261009T1801-copy.md", "first")
        self.write("box/inbox/broken.md", "---\nid: x\n")
        self.write("box/inbox/missing.md", "---\nid: \n---\n")
        self.letter("box/inbox/20260230T1800-date.md", "date")
        self.letter("box/inbox/20261009T1802-at.md", "at", at="wrong")
        result = self.run_cli(None, "--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(value["open"], [
            {"id": "first", "from": "sender", "to": "t", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 60}
        ])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"], {"box": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0}})
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
            {"file": "box/inbox/20260230T1800-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
            {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1801-copy.md", "why": "dup_id"},
            {"file": "box/inbox/20261009T1802-at.md", "why": "no_field"},
            {"file": "box/inbox/broken.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
            {"file": "box/inbox/missing.md", "why": "no_field"}
        ])

    def test_bad_cli_has_empty_stdout_and_exit_two(self):
        file_path = self.write("plain.txt", "data")
        for folder, options in (
            (self.root, ()),
            (self.root, ("--now", "invalid")),
            (self.root, ("--now", "2026-10-09T19:00:00")),
            (file_path, ("--now", NOW)),
            (self.root / "absent", ("--now", NOW))
        ):
            with self.subTest(folder=folder, options=options):
                result = self.run_cli(folder, *options)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

    def test_input_metadata_bytes_and_permissions_unchanged(self):
        letter = self.write("box/inbox/20261009T1800-a.md",
                            "---\nid: a\nfrom: s\nto: t\nstatus: REQUEST\n"
                            "at: 2026-10-09T18:00:00\n---\n")
        inbox = letter.parent
        inbox.chmod(0o555)
        self.root.chmod(0o555)

        def snapshot():
            paths = [self.root, *self.root.rglob("*")]
            result = {}
            for path in paths:
                info = path.lstat()
                result[path.relative_to(self.root).as_posix()] = (
                    stat.S_IFMT(info.st_mode), info.st_size, info.st_mode & 0o7777,
                    info.st_mtime_ns, path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else None)
            return result

        try:
            before = snapshot()
            result = self.run_cli(None, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(), before)
        finally:
            self.root.chmod(0o755)
            inbox.chmod(0o755)

    def test_symlink_file_and_mailbox_are_not_followed(self):
        source = self.write("box/inbox/20261009T1800-original.md",
                            "---\nid: original\nfrom: s\nto: t\nstatus: REQUEST\n"
                            "at: 2026-10-09T18:00:00\n---\n")
        try:
            (source.parent / "20261009T1801-link.md").symlink_to(source)
            (self.root / "linked").symlink_to(self.root / "box", target_is_directory=True)
        except (NotImplementedError, OSError) as exc:
            self.skipTest("symlinks unavailable: %s" % exc)
        result = self.run_cli(None, "--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(list(value["boxes"]), ["box"])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in value["open"]], ["original"])
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# REPORT

已修正測試對重複 id 的預期：依輸入相對路徑字典序，`alpha/inbox/20261009T1820-second.md` 先於 `alpha/inbox/done/20261009T1810-first.md`，因此前者有效，後者是 `dup_id`。交付範圍只有 `packs/mailtodo/` 的四個檔案及 `INDEX.md` 新增列；工具不呼叫既有寫入、修復或鎖定路徑。
